comparison_method: Compared the actually displayed original, usage720 and thumbnail320 images of both stages; no composite or new image created.

changes.observation: Tip moved slightly right and grip became thicker/rounder, while still crossing into the left text space.
Rim is slightly brighter; scratch marks remain distributed across its face.
All seven strings and essentially the same descending column were retained.
Paint detail is more contrasty, and dark grip pits remain prominent.

preserved_advantages: Installed same-door lock/key and handle relation
Grayscale daylight and no invented labels

residuals.observation: The center remains filled with crossing scratch-like marks. The outer rim is brighter, but broad face distress remains.
residuals.impact: Local grasp-rim wear still does not separate cleanly from general wear.

residuals.observation: The lever tip shifts slightly right but remains in the left text region. Title starts beneath the grip and its final first-line glyph approaches the lever underside.
residuals.impact: Requested title-at-grip adjacency is still absent; gap has narrowed.

residuals.observation: Grip is thicker and its dark pits/scratch marks remain pronounced within the bright patch.
residuals.impact: Metal is visually rougher than the desired quiet localized smoothing.

residuals.observation: The small information remains too small for comfortable full reading at 213×320; readable at usage720.
